how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-desolace-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:5386:obj:0: Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.
rows.quest:5386:details:0: The smell of cooked fish has long been missing here at Ghost Walker Post. The trolls at Shadowprey Village are the best at catching fish... but alas, with all the centaur activities I have little time to make a journey to the trolls. Hrm...
rows.quest:5386:details:1: BDo me a favor and journey to Shadowprey Village. Talk to the local fisherman Jinar'Zillen and bring me back my favorite, Bloodbelly fish. The road south of here will take you west to the troll village.
rows.quest:5386:completion:0: You are a savior, ⟦1⟧! These Bloodbelly fish look almost good enough to eat raw.
rows.quest:5386:completion:2: BHere you go - choose one of these items as a payment for these fish.
rows.quest:5501:obj:0: Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.
rows.quest:5501:details:0: We're sitting on a goldmine here, I tell you - a goldmine! Kodo bones will change the world forever... I have customers making furniture, music instruments, and even blasting powder out of them.
rows.quest:5501:details:1: BThere's a caravan that comes by and picks up my kodo bones and then sells them at Shadowprey Village. If you can travel to the kodo graveyard south of here and bring me ten kodo bones, I'll give you something in return. Is it a deal?
rows.quest:5501:completion:1: BI can't wait till the chaps at home see my face on the front cover of Goblin'preneur. I'll be the richest goblin in the world... and my physical education teacher said I would never amount to anything.
rows.quest:5561:obj:0: Bring five Tamed Kodos and the Kodo Kombobulator back to Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp.
rows.quest:5561:details:0: Bibbly thinks he is the only goblin in ⟦E1⟧ who knows how to make money. Well, the only caravan brave enough to travel these parts relies on me. Ever since I learned how to rejuvenate and control aged and dying kodos with my kodo kombobulator, the caravan owner Cork, Rigger, and I entered a partnership.
rows.quest:5561:details:1: BTake the kombobulator and use it on any ancient, aged, or dying kodos; it will jolt the beast into a tamed kodo and force it to follow you. Once you have a kodo tamed, bring it back to me.
rows.quest:5561:completion:1: BThree, four, and five... excellent, I ask for five tamed kodos and I get five tamed kodos... I am going to be rich... yes, very rich! I hope to see the look on Bibbly's green face when he hears about my success!
rows.quest:5581:obj:0: ⟦E2⟧ 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven and return to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.
rows.quest:5581:details:0: Behold - the Hand of Iruxos. A gruesome sight indeed.
rows.quest:5581:details:1: BYou must possess it if the demon portals at Mannoroc Coven are to be banished... which is what I now ask you to do. The Demon threat is increasing and we must close these portals to stem the tide of demons to this world. Good luck, ⟦3⟧... and be wary of the portal guardians.
rows.quest:5581:completion:0: You are to be commended, ⟦4⟧. Your effort has helped greatly in fighting the demon threat, and all of ⟦E3⟧ is safer because of it.
rows.quest:5741:obj:0: Get the Sceptre of Light and then return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.⟦5⟧
rows.quest:5741:details:0: The Burning Blade in Thunder Axe Fortress to the east is rumored to have acquired the Sceptre of Light from the Naga. Legend tells that the sceptre is able to sink entire cities under the great seas. The Burning Blade must not be allowed to possess such power.
rows.quest:5741:details:1: BTo that end, you must retrieve the sceptre yourself! It is held by a Burning Blade seer, who studies the sceptre from atop one of the Thunder Axe watchtowers.⟦6⟧
rows.quest:5741:completion:0: The elusive Sceptre of Light! Your acquisition of it has removed a grave threat to the world. Well done, ⟦7⟧, well done.
rows.quest:5763:obj:0: Bring ⟦E4⟧'s Kodo Horn to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.
rows.quest:5763:details:0: Long ago, a dwarf came to this land. His name was Hemet and he wished to hunt great beasts. His skills with the rifle were uncanny, and we spent many days hunting together. Even the enmity between our peoples was forgotten.
rows.quest:5763:details:1: BWhen he left ⟦E1⟧ for Stranglethorn, I vowed to one day welcome him back so that we may hunt again. Now is that time.
rows.quest:5763:details:2: BTake this kodo horn as a gift to Hemet. He will know it is from me. You will find him in Stranglethorn, north of the Grom'gol Base camp.
rows.quest:5763:completion:0: Ah, this horn belongs to a Tauren, ⟦E4⟧ Wildmane. He and I had a good time hunting the beasts of ⟦E1⟧. So ⟦E4⟧ is inviting me back, is he?
rows.quest:5763:completion:1: BWe're neck deep in the jungle right now, but thank you, ⟦8⟧. Perhaps my next expedition will take me back to ⟦E1⟧, the land of the centaurs.
rows.quest:5821:obj:0: Escort the Gizelton Caravan past the Kolkar Centaur village. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.
rows.quest:5821:details:0: Under normal circumstances, Rigger and I would lead our kodo past the Kolkar Centaur. Every now and then we hear the Centaur war drums, and when we hear those we stop. It's not good for business to be dead!
rows.quest:5821:details:1: BI'll tell you what ⟦9⟧, if you protect us past the Kolkar village we'll make it worth your while.
rows.quest:5821:details:2: BIt's just a short distance, all you need to do is keep the caravan intact and you can pick up your reward from Smeed Scrabblescrew - he is down the road a bit. We do a little business together.
rows.quest:5821:completion:0: You know, it doesn't seem prosperous to be paying the likes of you to guard Gizelton Caravan. ⟦10⟧, if I were a bit taller I could take on a second job and sit kodo-side-saddle with the biggest gun my hands could carry... and I'd show them blasted centaur who's their papa.
rows.quest:5943:obj:0: Escort the Gizelton Caravan through Mannoroc Coven. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.
rows.quest:5943:details:0: You look like a capable ⟦11⟧. Perhaps you're looking to make some money? Cork and I started this caravan to make a bundle of money; little did we know the dangers of turning a buck!
rows.quest:5943:details:1: BUp ahead is Mannoroc Coven... normally the demons ignore us but something has the kodos spooked this time. I'll pay you to protect the caravan past Mannoroc Coven. Once we are safely past you can receive your reward from our business associate Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp.
rows.quest:5943:completion:0: Not sure it's a prosperous proposition to be paying so much money to protect the Gizelton Caravan. Cork and Rigger only make one gold piece a week, but as long as they keep paying for my kodos I can care less how they run their business.
rows.quest:6027:obj:0: Get the Book of the Ancients and return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.⟦12⟧
rows.quest:6027:details:0: ⟦13⟧, I entrust you with the Gem of the Serpent. Place this gem on the Serpent Statue's hand on Ranazjar Isle, a small island northwest of here. Placing it will summon the one who protects the Book of the Ancients. This book contains the secrets of the naga, secrets that have been kept for centuries. Bring this book to me, and we will learn much about our scaled foes!
rows.quest:6027:completion:0: The long lost Book of the Ancients! I will ensure this book is passed on to the high council. You've done well today, and for that you are to be thanked... as a hero should be thanked!
rows.quest:6132:obj:0: Escort Melizza Brimbuzzle, then speak with Hornizz Brimbuzzle at the Kodo Graveyard in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:6132:details:1: BI came up to the Valley of Spears to talk to the Maraudines. I thought I could do a little business with them... but they don't want to talk! I think they want to eat me!
rows.quest:6132:details:2: BGet me out of here and my brother Hornizz will pay you big! He's at our camp next to the kodo graveyard, to the east.
rows.quest:6132:details:3: BLet's hurry, ⟦14⟧. Not two minutes ago I heard some centaurs talking about getting wood for their cookpot...
rows.quest:6132:completion:0: My sister Melizza said you'd be coming. Thanks a lot for getting her out of the jam she was in; it's too bad that she's already probably found herself in a new one!
rows.quest:6134:obj:0: Bring 8 Ghost-o-plasms and the Crate of Ghost Magnets to Hornizz Brimbuzzle in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:6134:details:0: There's a valley to the southeast, the ⟦E5⟧, haunted by Magram ghosts. Sounds scary, doesn't it? Well think how scary it is to the Magram! If we captured ghost energy from that place, I bet it'd be worth plenty to those centaurs.
rows.quest:6134:details:1: BHere, take this crate of ghost magnets. If you place one between the two big skeletons in the valley, the Dead Goliaths, then ghosts will wander to it. Distance yourself, take out the ghosts and get their ghost-o-plasm--that's what we'll sell to the Magram.
rows.quest:6134:completion:0: There it is! Looks like you got some of it on you too. Kinda slimey, eh?
rows.quest:6134:completion:1: BWell, thanks a lot for all the trouble, ⟦15⟧. This stuff will be worth a fortune... if I can convince the centaurs what it is!
rows.quest:6141:details:0: My brother in arms, Brother Anton, heard rumors of an undead infestation in distant ⟦E6⟧, in a land known as ⟦E1⟧. Anton immediately booked passage to that place, to seek and destroy the undead menace!
rows.quest:6141:details:1: BHe is looking for those with the bravery and resolve to aid him. If your heart is true, then speak with Anton. He is in ⟦E1⟧, in the ⟦E7⟧ town of Nijel's Point.
rows.quest:6141:completion:0: I received word of aid arriving from the east. Are you the source of these rumors? Have you come here to help the ⟦E8⟧ Brother in its crusade?
rows.quest:6142:obj:0: Find 10 pieces of Soft-shelled Clam Meat and bring it back to Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village.
rows.quest:6142:details:0: You have the look of a fisherman, ⟦16⟧! I love to fish - been fishing all my life. The best bait to use is soft-shelled clam meat; the fish just can't resist, you know what I mean?
rows.quest:6142:details:1: BUp north you will find a wrecked ship off the coast. Soft-shelled clams are littered throughout the area. If you bring me back 10 pieces of soft-shelled clam meat, I will give you something in return.
rows.quest:6142:completion:0: Perfect mon, this is just what the witch doctor told me to do for my headache. He says, ""Mai'Lahii - go fish. It'll make you feel better""
rows.quest:6142:completion:1: BWell, I feel better already, thanks mon!
rows.quest:6143:obj:0: Slay 7 Slitherblade Myrmidon, 7 Slitherblade Naga, and 5 Slitherblade Sorceresses, and then talk to Drulzegar at Shadowprey in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:6143:details:0: Maybe you heard or maybe you haven't... my crew and I was out fishing near Ranazjar Isle, north of the wrecked ship off the coast up north. We used to fish there all the time; now all I do is think of a way to seek revenge for my fallen comrades.
rows.quest:6143:details:1: BThe naga attacked us one morning, killing everyone except me.
rows.quest:6143:details:2: BMe conscience can't handle the guilt, ⟦17⟧; I need you to go and fry them naga for me. I'll make the effort worth your while; you think you can help me with that?
rows.quest:6143:completion:0: As sweet as it is hearing the news that the naga have been vanquished, my heart still feels empty. For the rest of my life I will be dedicated to having them all killed.
rows.quest:6143:completion:1: BHere mon, your reward as I promised. It's small in comparison to the gratification of knowing the naga fried for their hated act upon my crew.
rows.quest:6161:obj:0: Find Rackmore's Silver Key. Find Rackmore's Golden Key. Find and open Rackmore's Chest.
rows.quest:6161:details:0: Rackmore's log tells of how his ship was sailing for Feathermoon Stronghold when it was attacked by seafaring creatures. To prevent his treasure from falling into enemy hands, he hid his chest on Ranazjar Isle.
rows.quest:6161:details:1: BTo open the chest requires two keys, a silver and a gold. These keys were lost, but if the keys and the chest are found, a treasure awaits!
rows.quest:6161:completion:0: Chest opens to reveal Rackmore's treasure!
rows.quest:6568:obj:0: Deliver Rexxar's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:6568:details:0: Illusion and disguise. That is how you will fool the Black Dragonflight, and gain what you seek.
rows.quest:6568:details:1: BThough I could teach you something of the skills of deception, you need the help of a master.
rows.quest:6568:details:2: BI know of one who could do this. In the ⟦E9⟧, you will find Myranda the Hag, once a master illusionist of Lordaeron. She has helped us in the past, and if she believes the cause worthy, she may help you.
rows.quest:6568:completion:0: <Myranda holds the note, pauses, then smiles.>
rows.quest:6568:completion:1: BHow is he? Rexxar, I mean. Oh, come now, do not look so confused. The letter was left intentionally blank. It carried with it the intentions and thoughts of its creator. Judging from its contents, it is no wonder Rexxar left it as such. Imagine if you were captured or slain and this information discovered!
rows.quest:6568:completion:2: BOh, nevermind! Myranda will help you, ⟦18⟧. I owe the Warchief a favor or two.
